{{Quotation|game|
This small mountain town has stood in one form or another for almost eight hundred years, as can be seen by the traditional stone architecture of indisputably [[Cantha]]n origin. Once a way station for weary travelers and swift-footed messengers, it has of late become a popular vacation spot for wealthy Canthan tourists who value its remote location.
}}

==Getting there==
* This outpost is located at the northwest corner of [[Maishang Hills]]. From [[Cavalon]] go outside to [[Archipelagos]] and head northeast through the [[portal]] into Maishang Hills.
* Another way is to leave from [[Eredon Terrace]] and go west.
